description: Use when configuring path aliases, CSS modules, CSS preprocessors, PostCSS, Lightning CSS, or module resolution behavior. Prevents resolve.alias misconfiguration breaking imports and CSS preprocessor options not matching the installed preprocessor version. Covers resolve.alias, resolve.dedupe, resolve.conditions, resolve.extensions, resolve.tsconfigPaths, css.modules, css.postcss, css.preprocessorOptions (Sass/Less/Stylus), css.transformer, css.lightningcss, css.devSourcemap, json.namedExports, json.stringify, and html.cspNonce. Keywords: vite, resolve, alias, CSS modules, PostCSS, Lightning CSS, Sass, preprocessor.
